mu_name_from: MuMain _enum.h MONSTER_SILVER_VALKYRIE (52), drawn out of the Valkyrie's model (MONSTER_MODEL_VALKYRIE, Monster36.bmd). OpenMU Version075 Maps/Atlans.cs names breed 52 'Silver Valkyrie'. docs/atlans-port.md Part B 4.
monster_from: ZzzCharacter.cpp:13769-13774, CreateMonster, case MONSTER_SILVER_VALKYRIE: OpenMonsterModel(MONSTER_MODEL_VALKYRIE); CreateCharacter(Key, MODEL_VALKYRIE, ...); Scale = 1.4f; Weapon[0] = MODEL_BLUEWING_CROSSBOW. No BlendMesh, so its body is drawn solid -- not the Valkyrie's glow -- and then again with RENDER_CHROME | RENDER_BRIGHT in its body colour at Bright 1, with the Balrog and the golden monsters (:8716-8785): a silver warrior. Its own build of Monster36 for that, since the Valkyrie's bakes the body as a glow.
right_hand_from: Weapon[0], the Bluewing Crossbow, on link bone 30 (knife_gdf), as the Valkyrie's.
plus_from: MU's second pass, RENDER_CHROME | RENDER_BRIGHT in white, is the chrome a +7 item is drawn with (shine.sh: Chrome01 added, the base at 0.8): the body at +7, white rather than the orange a body with no item row would take.
rig_from: Monster36 again: seven actions, 41 bones, BoneHead 19 (ZzzOpenData.cpp:3653-3659).
sheet_from: The Valkyrie's two sheets, valkyrie_gp01 (the dark finned plate) and valkyrie_gp02 (the blue fins).
sheet_materials_from: Plate, the body solid here; the fins a membrane, blended as the Valkyrie's.
soft_alpha_from: gp02.OZT tested and blended, as the Valkyrie's fins.
sounds_from: The Valkyrie's model's: SetMonsterSound(..., 135, 135, 136, 136, 137) in ZzzOpenData.cpp:3653-3659. Wired as silvervalkyrie_* in sounds.json, as valkyrie_*.
islands_from: 6 islands for 655 triangles. Islands 0-2 are gp01, the body (638), plate_steel; 3-5 are gp02, the fins (17), leather and blended (soft_alpha). They arrived as skin.
